verdict.rationale: Community Phone documents two-way SMS on Business Plus, missed-call alerts sent to the user, custom voice greetings, and automated check-in calls for loved ones. None of these is an automated text reply, missed-call text-back, after-hours SMS reply, or scheduled text. Missed-call alerts notify the account holder rather than texting the caller, and the automated feature uses voice calls, so these are adjacent features that earn no credit.
